fr_boucler_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe kneels and BUCKLES his shoe with a big shiny silver BUCKLE (boo-KLAY).
fr_boucler_verb.why: Boucle = buckle (or curl) → boucler = to buckle, to fasten; the mime fastens the buckle. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_tousser_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe COUGHS into his elbow so hard his beret flies off and his TOUPEE (too-SAY) wobbles!
fr_tousser_verb.why: 'TOUPEE' ≈ tousser = to cough; the cough blows the toupee up. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_eriger_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe hauls on the rope and ERECTS a tall flagpole over the herb garden, high as a RIDGE (ay-ree-ZHAY).
fr_eriger_verb.why: Erect / ériger sound alike → ériger = to erect, put up; the mime raises the pole upright. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_concentrer_verb.hook: Waiter Monsieur Verbe CONCENTRATES hard on his TRAY of lemonades (kohn-sahn-TRAY) – even with a fly on his nose; the hand mirror in his hand says se concentrer.
fr_concentrer_verb.why: Concentrate → se concentrer = to concentrate; '-TRAY' ending, he stares at the tray. The hand mirror shows it is reflexive (se). Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_assimiler_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe's giant sponge ABSORBS the whole bucket of water – it ASSIMILATES every drop (ah-see-mee-LAY).
fr_assimiler_verb.why: Assimilate → assimiler = to absorb, assimilate; the sponge takes it all in. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_maigrir_verb.hook: After a summer of MEAGER little salads (may-GREER), Monsieur Verbe has SLIMMED DOWN – look how baggy his pants are now!
fr_maigrir_verb.why: 'MEAGER' ≈ maigre (thin) → maigrir = to slim, get thinner. Regular -ir (nous maigrissons): GREEN beret.

fr_vaciller_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe cups his hands round the candle – the flame FLICKERS and wobbles: it VACILLATES (vah-see-YAY).
fr_vaciller_verb.why: Vacillate → vaciller = to waver, to flicker; the flame wobbles in the breeze. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_dechirer_verb.hook: Riiip! Monsieur Verbe TEARS his trouser leg on the picket fence (day-shee-RAY).
fr_dechirer_verb.why: The rip in the pants → déchirer = to tear, rip. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_sacrifier_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe SACRIFICES his lunch: he hands his big sandwich to a hungry little dog (sah-kree-FYAY).
fr_sacrifier_verb.why: Sacrifice → sacrifier = to sacrifice, give up; the mime gives up his sandwich. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_abimer_verb.hook: A BEE MAY (ah-bee-MAY) land on Monsieur Verbe's cake – and it DAMAGES the icing with a big dent!
fr_abimer_verb.why: 'a-BEE-MAY' ≈ abîmer = to damage, spoil; the bee spoils the cake. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_peiner_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe STRUGGLES to push a cart of giant PENcils up the slope – what a PAIN (pay-NAY)!
fr_peiner_verb.why: Peine = pain, effort → peiner = to struggle, toil. Regular -er: RED beret. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (peh-NAY -> pay-NAY).

fr_subir_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe bravely UNDERGOES a check-up on his stool, and the smiling doctor with the stethoscope beams: 'SUPERB!' (sew-BEEHR).
fr_subir_verb.why: 'SUPERB' ≈ subir = to undergo; he goes through the check-up. Regular -ir (nous subissons): GREEN beret.

fr_soulager_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe RELIEVES the tired donkey: he lifts the heavy sack off its back – SO LIGHT now (soo-lah-ZHAY)!
fr_soulager_verb.why: Soulagement = relief → soulager = to relieve, ease; the donkey's load is lifted. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_resider_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe RESIDES by his little cottage – lazing in his hammock DAY after DAY (ray-zee-DAY).
fr_resider_verb.why: Reside / résider sound alike; résidence = home → résider = to live, reside. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_survivre_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe's cactus SURVIVES a whole month with an empty watering can – SURE, VIVA (sewr-VEEVR)!
fr_survivre_verb.why: Sur + vivre (live on) → survivre = to survive. Like vivre, irregular: GOLD beret.

fr_evanouir_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe sees A VAN of tiny spiders (ay-vah-noo-EER) and FAINTS onto his cushion, his hand mirror slipping: s'évanouir.
fr_evanouir_verb.why: 'A VAN-ooh!' – he swoons at the van → s'évanouir = to faint. The hand mirror shows it is reflexive (s'). GOLD beret = irregular.

fr_deprimer_verb.hook: It's MAY, and Monsieur Verbe is DOWN in the dumps: his snowman is melting away in the rose garden (day-pree-MAY).
fr_deprimer_verb.why: Depress / déprimer → déprimer = to depress, to feel down; the mime sits glumly by the melting snowman. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_guerir_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe has a CAREER (gay-REER) mending toys: he HEALS the rocking horse's leg with a bandage.
fr_guerir_verb.why: 'CAREER' ≈ guérir = to cure, heal; the toy is made well again. Regular -ir (nous guérissons): GREEN beret.

fr_renaitre_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe cheers as the golden phoenix is REBORN from the ashes – a RENAISSANCE (ruh-NEHTR)!
fr_renaitre_verb.why: Re + naître (be born) → renaître = to be reborn; Renaissance = rebirth. Irregular like naître: GOLD beret.

fr_denouer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe UNTIES a huge knot – a NEW WAY for the rope (day-NWAY)!
fr_denouer_verb.why: Dé + nouer (to knot) → dénouer = to undo, untie, unravel. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_revivre_verb.hook: Older now, with his medal on, Monsieur Verbe RELIVES his best days in his picture album (ruh-VEEVR).
fr_revivre_verb.why: Re + vivre (live) → revivre = to relive, live again. Irregular like vivre: GOLD beret.
